scope: homepage Pokémon Championship Series section only

evidencePolicy.source: Attempt 11 frozen captures, archived source assets, live-DOM observations reported during the same run, and computed-style facts from that run only
evidencePolicy.absolutePageY: non-structural only; page-level Y drift was observed and is not used as a fidelity invariant

claims.claim: The first complete high-salience section after TCG Pocket is POKÉMON CHAMPIONSHIP SERIES and the next section is Play! Pokémon.

dom.subject: live article.championships and adjacent rendered articles
dom.fact: Championship Series is rendered after TCG Pocket and before Play! Pokémon.

claims.claim: At 1440 the section is a transparent 1440x720 row-reverse composition: content left and a 720x720 official image right; no observed pseudo-element or child background creates the white field.

dom.subject: article, row, image column, content column, content box
dom.fact: row display:flex; flex-direction:row-reverse; article/row/columns/content backgrounds transparent; no pseudo fill observed

claims.claim: At 390 the row becomes block and reading order is image first, then copy and CTA; the section remains transparent over the white page canvas.

dom.subject: article.championships row and children
dom.fact: display:block; image DOM/visual first, content second; all inspected backgrounds transparent

claims.claim: Both official square candidates are archived: championships.jpg is 696x696 with SHA-256 0f7fb0ab417f1b2076343573a676b71629722e30e252147f11f4ef3966eb918d, and championships-2x.jpg is 1392x1392 with SHA-256 862a5f138e77cb6e0a8fdb44538a19d9ddfa3d60328b2113b6ae48f8000895db. In the observed 390px browser session src declared the 1x URL while currentSrc selected the 2x URL.

dom.subject: Championship Series img
dom.fact: src ends championships.jpg; srcset declares 1x and 2x; observed mobile currentSrc ends championships-2x.jpg; naturalWidth/naturalHeight=696/696

claims.claim: The 390px copy stack uses a three-line Kanit heading, PT Sans body copy and a centered black CTA with the frozen dimensions and spacing.

dom.subject: content h2, p and a.button
dom.fact: heading then paragraph then Learn more CTA

claims.claim: Desktop default, hover transition, hover settled, keyboard focus and activated destination are independently frozen; href/destination is https://championships.pokemon.com/en-us/.

computed.note: The CSS rule is archived; captures freeze endpoints/transition but do not establish capture timestamps.

dom.subject: document scrolling element
dom.fact: same homepage context was scrolled to the target and restored

claims.claim: Mobile default, hover-settled, keyboard focus and activated destination are independently frozen at 390x844.

dom.subject: mobile a.button
dom.fact: href and activated final URL both equal https://championships.pokemon.com/en-us/
